scope: Additive redistribution-rights audit for battlefield art of the six permanent Home Village Heroes. This record grants no asset permission and changes no combat geometry.
game_version: TH18 scope as of 2026-09-23; art policy is independent of client build. Upstream asset source pinned at 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Fan Content Policy
facts: The policy limits use of Supercell Assets in fan content to displaying, identifying and discussing Supercell products.
It says new products or content based on Supercell Assets, including games based on Supercell game characters, are not permitted even if free.
It says Supercell Assets may not be modified without express permission.
sources.limitations: The page supplies no project-specific permission for this simulator or a separately licensed set of battlefield Hero sprite sheets. Whether a particular simulator distribution qualifies under the policy requires rights-holder clarification.

sources.title: Pinned repository LICENSE
facts: The pinned repository has an MIT license by its repository author.
sources.limitations: The text does not identify a separate Supercell grant for copyrighted game characters or battlefield art. It cannot by itself verify that the repository author can sublicense those rights.

sources.title: Pinned repository README
facts: The pinned README says the package includes image assets and identifies Clash of Clans Wiki as its game-data source.
sources.limitations: Bundling images and attributing a data source do not establish rights-holder permission for this simulator to redistribute battlefield Hero sprites.

local_context.fact: The repository already describes fetched upstream images as local-viewer use only and instructs a rights check before redistribution.

derivations.result: Keep battlefield Hero art rights unverified; do not mark upstream game images as freely redistributable.
derivations.method: Compare the rights-holder policy against the exact pinned repository license, README and the local asset-provenance notice. No project-specific permission was found in these checked documents.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the upstream MIT license as a grant of Supercell character-art rights
rejected_inferences.reason: The checked license identifies the repository author, not a separate rights-holder grant for game art.

rejected_inferences.rule: Download or redistribute client-extracted battlefield sprite sheets because existing icons are available locally
rejected_inferences.reason: Asset availability does not resolve permission, and the policy explicitly limits uses of Supercell Assets.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat original symbolic markers as verified client battlefield sprites
rejected_inferences.reason: Original markers could support a viewer but would not establish the game's sprite artwork, scale, anchor or animations.

items: express compatible permission for battlefield Hero sprites, or independently created redistributable art
per-Hero client sprite scale, world anchor and animation bounds
rights for modifying, packaging or publishing any current local upstream images

conclusion: The checked policy and pinned repository files do not establish compatible redistribution rights for battlefield Hero sprites in this simulator. The art axis remains partial; no game-derived sprite is newly packaged or claimed as licensed by this audit.
